title: MONSTER V6 Step 5 - Semantic UI Verifier Contract
problem: UI proofs can falsely fail when framework-internal DOM descendants, generated classes, element order, or arbitrary child-size thresholds change while the visible user-facing capability still works.
root_cause: Verifier acceptance has sometimes encoded implementation shape instead of durable user-visible semantics such as role, accessible name, visible wrapper, interaction, route outcome, and visible text.

historical_evidence.first_root_cause: framework-internal data-baseweb descendant markup was treated as a durable public DOM contract
historical_evidence.second_root_cause: an arbitrary 28px internal-child height threshold was enforced even though the visible wrapper and real interactive control were healthy

patch: Add a dependency-light semantic UI verification contract that proves unique visible interactive capabilities by role/name or label, route/text outcomes by visible semantics, wrapper-level style acceptance, and rejects framework-internal/positional selector truth.
